hypothesis: A small observable soccer regime may give the existing original forecasting policy lower proper-score loss than its contemporaneous market baseline, reproducibly across a chronological development partition.
design: Post-hoc development specialization screen; four fixed slices selected on earlier matches and assessed once on later matches. Existing repeated forecast tape, no training, inference, changed execution or closed-loop claims.
prior_use: Known earlier-run-risk report and first task/match schemas inspected; all cohort has repeated prior development use. No new D8 aggregate results inspected before registration.
model: original forecast-rules-run-3 repeated-validation recorded agent, same checkpoint and tape across all slices
intervention: Evaluate forecasts only at observations satisfying one predeclared regime; retain recorded probabilities and market baseline. No altered trading policy.

slices.observed_red_card: at least one red in anchored Red cards: prefix line; reject unsupported/missing parse; do not infer from future events
slices.large_observed_price_move: max absolute shown-price change >= 0.15 from previous available sparse observation in same recorded trajectory, chronologically; first observation excluded

choice_criterion.primary: greatest positive market-minus-model multiclass Brier improvement, equal match weighting, invalid-inclusive
choice_criterion.secondary_requirement: positive market-minus-model clipped log loss improvement
choice_criterion.no_qualifier: Freeze no candidate; later slice scores descriptive only; negative screen cannot promote later-positive slice

invalid_definition: Stored valid plus finite probability vector in [0,1], mass within original 0.05 tolerance, normalize; invalid penalized and separate valid-only scores.
market: task scoring.market_probs, normalized current shown YES quotes (not executable bid/ask)

bootstrap.unit: whole match, retain all repeats and observations; average within match then resample matched difference
bootstrap.limitations: shared teams not clustered; selection and four-way multiplicity not corrected; intervals conditional/descriptive

stopping_rule: One four-slice screen on earlier39; freeze candidate before later33 aggregation; assess once, no tuning, reselecting, retraining or paid calls. Promising only selected candidate with >=5 later matches and Brier/log-loss paired lower CI >0; negative if no eligible fit improvement; otherwise inconclusive.
spend: $0; no paid work authorized for D8; latest entire execution task cap $5 supersedes obsolete per-direction budget
limitations: No execution-policy evaluation, no maker returns, no untouched holdout.
Proper-score skill is not trading profitability.
Original forecasts condition on recorded original position; specialization is an observational screen.
